prompts.clearing: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final playable 2D game background, 16:9 landscape. Primary request: beautiful cohesive pixel art for a small top-down hunting game, warm early-morning woodland clearing. Camera is an elevated oblique top-down game camera looking down across a flat meadow, not a side-view landscape, no sky or visible horizon. Final logical game canvas 640 by 360 pixels, make square pixel clusters with deliberate sharp stepped edges and no blur. Dense layered spruce and birch woodland hugs ONLY the upper quarter and the far left and right borders. Most of the middle and lower field is open, softly textured sage and olive grass with small ochre patches, scattered tiny tufts, subtle low ferns, a few muted wildflowers. Clear playing space across the entire central band, so deer silhouettes are easy to see. Warm dusty gold sunlight from upper left, long subtle shadows to lower right, subdued forest green shadows, a little atmospheric depth in the distant trees. Rich but restrained polished indie pixel-art game aesthetic, thoughtful silhouettes and layered canopies, natural asymmetry, no neon green, no black outlines. At bottom center reserve a small clear earthy patch where a separate hunting platform and hunter will be drawn; do not draw a platform yourself. NO animals, people, rifles, buildings, UI, text, border, logos, or watermark. Entire image is the game environment, no mockup frame, no sprite sheet. Output an opaque wide 16:9 image.
prompts.deer: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent pixel-art deer sprite for a playable 2D woodland hunting game. Primary request: an elegant readable adult white-tailed buck, full body strict side profile facing RIGHT, standing calmly, all four legs visibly separated with real transparent gaps, natural rather than cartoonish proportions. Full antlers, ears, small black nose and eye, pale throat and underside, russet tan body, lighter shoulder and back, dark hooves, a small white tail on the LEFT rump. The torso should span much of the width, the front shoulder is around 65 percent of the way across from the left, and halfway up from the hooves. Clean exact silhouette with antlers that read at tiny size. Style: polished indie-game pixel art at a logical sprite size around 64 by 48 pixels, sharp deliberate square pixel clusters, restrained palette of warm ochre, tan, walnut, cream, olive shadow. Soft directional golden morning light from upper left, shadow on lower right, no black outline, no painting blur, no antialiasing. It must match a muted sage woodland meadow. Composition: exactly ONE deer, centered, full body and all antlers and hooves inside the image, no ground plane or cast shadow. Background is genuinely transparent, not white and not checkerboard. No extra animals, environment, icons, text, labels, panels, sprite sheet, watermark, or UI. This is a standalone production game sprite, not a concept-art scene.
prompts.hunter: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent pixel-art hunter character sprite for a playable 2D woodland game. Primary request: full-body rear view of an adult hunter facing directly AWAY from the camera into the screen, from a slightly elevated game viewpoint. Worn muted rust-orange hunting jacket, olive trousers, walnut hiking boots, dark brown brimmed cap. Readable cap brim, shoulder blades, jacket seams, belt and two distinct trouser legs. Arms rest forward at chest height as if holding a rifle aimed away from camera, but do NOT draw a long rifle barrel, it is drawn and rotated separately in the game. Calm grounded stance, compact natural proportions, about 40 by 64 logical pixels with sharp deliberate square pixel clusters and stepped edges. Polished indie pixel-art aesthetic with warm dusty gold morning light from upper left, subtle shadows on lower right; limited subdued olive, terracotta, tan and walnut palette, no neon orange, no hard black outline, no antialiasing, no blur, no photorealism. Exactly ONE character, full body fully visible, centered, no ground or cast shadow. Background is genuinely transparent, not white and not checkerboard. No environment, animals, text, watermark, UI, border or sprite sheet.
